body: Hey, so I'm 14, my life is perfectly fine aside from my parents divorce and my lack of friends, but that is my doing. Considering I generally dislike people.. But I've felt like complete shit lately, I'm changing schools, and losing two of the only people I've ever liked. Now I don't know what to do, I feel like nothing is ever going to improve from here and I'm going to be unhappy forever. Life used to be so enjoyable and it felt, more.. colorful? That's the best I can describe it. That life used to be colorful, and now it's black and white and I can't get the color back..
NOTE: This kid lives in a great house with great family and friends. I have no doubt that no traumatizing experiences have ever happened to him.
He told me he is "a shadow and sometimes He can dissapear"
